pipeline_mapping: the named upstream source behind `Deep Space Network time` (rc-030: $1,530/hr, whose note cites 'MOCS FY09 $1,057/hr CPI-adjusted'): the MOCS document itself, with the fee algorithm AF = RB x [AW x (0.9 + FC/10)] (Eq. 2-1), contact-dependent rate RB '$1057/hr. for FY09' (so the FY09 figure upstream's note cites is MOCS's), aperture weights 0.80 (34 m high-speed beam waveguide), 1.00 (other 34 m), 2-4.00 for 34 m arrays and 4.00 for the 70 m.
